children: India will finalize a trade deal with the US once Washington offers tariff terms that give its exporters an advantage over competitors, Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal said, according to Bloomberg.
Goyal said the preferential tariff rate is a key sticking point in the prolonged negotiations between the two countries.

title: India Says US Trade Deal Depends on Preferential Tariffs
